decision_object.decision_statement: Should the candidate proceed with a turbine pilot opportunity as presently represented, given the operating-authority evidence in the frozen record?
decision_object.freshness_warning: Evidence is frozen at 30 Jun 2026. Do not treat this demonstration as a current verification of any real operator, certificate, person, or authority state.

recommendation.plain_language: Do not accept the position as presently represented.
recommendation.nearest_alternative: Defer commitment and require authoritative evidence of a valid, applicable operating-authority structure.
recommendation.next_action: Obtain authoritative evidence that the contemplated employment and flying are covered by valid operating authority before accepting or beginning training.
recommendation.change_condition: Authoritative evidence establishing a valid, applicable operating-authority structure for the contemplated employment and flying.

confidence_architecture.explanation: Decision-critical authority evidence is strong, while broader case coverage remains incomplete. Confidence and coverage are not the same measure.
confidence_architecture.low_confidence_behavior: If decision confidence is Low, the primary screen must state Low explicitly, suppress any visual treatment that implies numeric precision, identify the evidence gap, and present the next information-acquisition action or abstention condition.

authority_state.customer_meaning: This qualification artifact was not authorized for customer release. A production Decision Room must not present a blocked recommendation as released advice.

economic_exposure.display: Economic exposure is material but not responsibly quantifiable from the frozen record.
economic_exposure.limitations: The packet includes favorable compensation and schedule terms but does not contain sufficient verified economic inputs for a defensible ROI, savings, avoided-loss, or quantified exposure claim.

alternatives.label: Accept as represented
alternatives.rationale: Favorable compensation, schedule, urgency, and withdrawal flexibility do not cure a critical adverse authority condition.

alternatives.label: Defer pending authoritative cure
alternatives.rationale: Preserves the opportunity while requiring evidence that can actually change the authority state.

alternatives.label: Decline and move on
alternatives.rationale: Removes the authority uncertainty but may surrender a potentially attractive opportunity that could become supportable if valid authority is established.

decisive_claims.claim: The represented certificate was surrendered effective 2026-05-31 and operations under it were not authorized thereafter.
The frozen record contains no replacement certificate, exemption, temporary authority, stay, regulator correction, or regulator statement curing the represented authority state.
The packet does not establish that the named affiliate holds authority applicable to this employment opportunity.

evidence.title: Regulator-originated certificate-status record
evidence.provenance: Controlled primary regulator-originated record; identity and date established within the frozen synthetic packet.

evidence.title: Regulator enforcement notice
evidence.provenance: Controlled regulator-originated notice addressed to the represented employer.

evidence.title: Recruiter follow-up message
evidence.provenance: Controlled first-party message; admissible as evidence of the representation, not as regulator authority.

evidence.title: Operations manager affiliate-transition message
evidence.provenance: Controlled first-party message; no accompanying evidence establishes the affiliate as the applicable authority holder for the offer.

evidence.title: Candidate urgency and favorable employment terms

unknowns_and_contradictions.statement: Recruiter and operations-manager representations conflict with the regulator-originated certificate-status record.
unknowns_and_contradictions.disposition: Authoritative evidence controls the supported authority state.

unknowns_and_contradictions.statement: Whether a different valid authority structure could lawfully cover the contemplated employment and flying.
unknowns_and_contradictions.disposition: Requires authoritative evidence before recommendation can change.

unknowns_and_contradictions.statement: The enforcement notice does not prove that any unauthorized revenue flight actually occurred.
unknowns_and_contradictions.disposition: Do not infer beyond the record.

falsification.strongest_contrary_case: The recruiter and operations manager assert that authority remains valid or is transitioning to an affiliate, while the opportunity has favorable terms and is reversible before training.
falsification.result: Does not reverse the recommendation because no authoritative cure is present in the frozen record.

decision_delta.reason: This is a synthetic pre-decision demonstration. No real customer decision or subsequent real-world outcome exists, so no Decision Delta or performance claim is displayed.

abstention.label: ABSTAIN / INSUFFICIENT BASIS
abstention.rule: Use only when the canonical recommendation state is abstention or the governed record says evidence is insufficient. The presentation layer may not derive abstention itself.

low_confidence.label: Low
low_confidence.rule: Render the canonical qualitative confidence exactly and explain the limiting evidence; never convert it to a numeric score.

release_blocked.rule: Display blocked state prominently and do not frame the recommendation as released customer advice.

stale_data.rule: Display evidence cutoff and a warning whenever the canonical freshness state is frozen, stale, expired, or otherwise not current.
